title: Committed-input reader ignores system/global core.longpaths, so a long-path submodule enabled only globally is refused
outcome: On Windows, a clean checkout whose child paths exceed MAX_PATH, with core.longpaths=true set only in system or global Git config, is either admitted by the committed-input lane or refused with a reason that names the missing repository-local core.longpaths and the remedy. Today it fails closed with a dirt-like refusal.
acceptance: Committed-input reader ignores system/global core.longpaths, so a long-path submodule enabled only globally is refused is done
